{{Top|leg}}
The '''Head Clan''' was the name of the fifteen leaders of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]]. Descended from one of the original settlers, each member worked with the others as a body to make decisions. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took control of Stassia, the Head Clan's power was greatly reduced.
